suggested_services_note: Each row is one way this kind of work takes money (one of the master's 28 paths per flow). The owner keeps the services that fit and picks ONE path per service and place. Names and amounts are examples from the profession file, not prices.

suggested_services.name: Heartsaver CPR and first aid
suggested_services.example: The main story: Alex's seat in Saturday's 9am Heartsaver class, $95, paid in full when booking. A student who doesn't pass the skills check gets no card that day and one free retest within 30 days.

suggested_services.name: Company account seat
suggested_services.example: A company account: the company's contact books seats for named staff, nothing is taken, and the company gets one bill a month.

suggested_services.name: On-site class (9 students)
suggested_services.example: The main story: an on-site class for 9 staff at Alex's office, $85 a student ($765), nothing taken to book; the bill comes after the class for the final count (at least 6 students, $510).

suggested_services.name: Family class at home
suggested_services.example: A family or babysitter class at home for up to 4 people, $300, paid in full when booking.

before_times: which course, and if it's for a job or a board (some accept only certain programs)
a new card or a renewal (a renewal brings a current card that's still in date)
how many students, for a group or an on-site class
for a blended course: is the online part done
after_time: each student's full name as it should read on the card, and an email for the card
anything the instructor should know to help, like trouble kneeling, a hearing need or a language
secure_page_only: each student's name, email and, where the program asks, date of birth
a physical limit that affects doing compressions on the floor (it may mean a course completion without a card)
for a student under 18: the parent's OK and who picks them up
for a company's student: whether the company may see their attendance and card
intake_questions.who_may_book: an adult for themselves; a parent or guardian for a student under 18 (12 and up for CPR courses, 11 to 15 for the babysitter course); a company's contact for named staff, each of whom gets their own card

stop.words: someone collapsed or not breathing right now, choking, chest pain, a stroke sign
stop.say: Call 911 now. Start CPR if they're not breathing normally, and use an AED if one is near.

go_on.words: pregnant, a bad knee or back, a recent surgery
go_on.what: the booking goes on; the instructor helps with ways to practice; a card needs the skills the program requires; Rosie gives no health advice

go_on.words: a student booking after a recent death or a scary event
go_on.what: the booking goes on, kindly; crisis words get the crisis line

steps.name: Blended course: the online part
steps.when: due 24 hours before the skills session
steps.result: the certificate uploaded on the secure page; not in time: the session moves to a later date, free once

steps.name: Renewal: the current card
steps.when: on the secure page while booking
steps.result: a card still in date is shown at check-in; an expired one is a full course

steps.name: On-site class: the final student list
steps.result: the final list, with each name as it should read on the card, sets the bill; late: the owner is told, and nothing is cancelled for it

steps.name: Under 18: the parent's OK
steps.when: on the secure page while booking
steps.result: no OK: the student isn't booked

first_steps_and_forms.prep: wear clothes you can kneel in; bring a photo ID (the card's name is checked against it); bring the online certificate for a blended course

staff.skills: courses each instructor may teach, languages, teaching minors, on-site travel
staff.licenses_or_certificates: each instructor's card for the courses taught, under a program or training center: the business's own word, never checked by Rosie
staff.who_oks: Sam OKs company accounts, on-site classes and refunds
staff.stand_in: another instructor certified for the same course; students in a public class aren't asked; a company that named an instructor is asked first, and nobody moves on silence
staff.ratio: the program's limits: up to 6 students per manikin station and 12 per instructor; a second instructor for larger classes

children_and_age.who_may_book: an adult for themselves; a parent or guardian for a student under 18 (12 and up for CPR courses, 11 to 15 for the babysitter course); a company's contact for named staff, each of whom gets their own card
children_and_age.minors_texts: texts go to the parent who booked

visit.check_in: the instructor ticks each student on the class roster, or takes each student's own code; an on-site class checks in on the company's list
visit.done: the instructor texts DONE once the roster and the results are in
visit.changes_at_visit: an extra student added on site is priced at the per-student rate, and the company says yes first

license.note: Optional. Upload anything. Rosie never checks it and never shows it as checked (D96).
license.need: none from the state for teaching CPR and first aid in most places; each instructor holds a current instructor card from a nationally recognized program (the program's own card, which the business shows as its word); where a state agency approves providers for some uses (child care staff, school staff), the business shows only the approvals it really holds
license.who: the business, for its registration and any provider approval; each instructor, for their instructor card and the courses it covers
license.ask: the business registration; each instructor's card: the courses it covers and its end date; the program or training center the business teaches under; any provider approval
license.insurance: liability insurance: the business's own word, shown once it's sent
license.background: background checks for instructors who teach minors or at schools: the business's own word, where the school or its rules ask

never_in_a_text: test results (passed or not), health or physical limits, dates of birth: only on the secure page
languages: English and Spanish; classes in other languages where an instructor teaches in them
